basic_info.description:
Bright SOMA Apartment with Classic Touches

715 Clementina offers a comfortable blend of historic charm and updated finishes. This home features a gas stove, recessed lighting, built-in shelving, and sleek tile flooring. Nestled in a classic blue Victorian, the apartment is just steps from Costco, Sightglass Coffee, Cat Club, and Cadillac Bar & Grill, with theaters and museums nearby. A great choice for those who want convenience, culture, and nightlife all within reach.

Amenities
Cable Ready
Gas Range
Large Closets
Refrigerator
Window Covering

Details
Neighborhood: SOMA
Building: 715 Clementina
Rent Controlled
12 Month Lease Terms
Street Parking Only

Pets
Cats welcome, Dogs welcome
Pets under 40 lbs allowed

Extras
New lease includes one year free of laundry service with the Rinse Repeat subscription. Receive one bag of wash/dry/fold laundry service per month FREE, picked up and delivered to your door. One bag is equivalent to 4 loads of laundry. Valued at $600.

This unit is a rental unit subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, which limits evictions without just cause, and which states that any waiver by a tenant of their rights under the Rent Ordinance is void as contrary to public policy.

12 month lease term
Tenant responsible for utilities
